name: Keekan SEO
author: keekan

sections.description:
Keekan SEO is a modern SEO plugin for WordPress built for site owners, publishers, and businesses who care about search visibility, commercial intent, Google compliant SEO to rank higher and long-term value — not just SEO scores.

It combines essential on-page SEO tools with High RPM keyword suggestions, competitor website analytics with competitive keywords tracking and content workflows to help you focus on higher-value search opportunities and scalable publishing.

Why Keekan SEO

Most SEO plugins focus on technical checklists.
Keekan SEO focuses on what matters for growth.

  • Google, Bing, Yandex and Duck Duck Go compliant full SEO to rank higher in search results
  • Prioritize keywords with commercial and business intent
  • Build pages designed for search visibility and conversions
  • Use AI-assisted workflows to scale content efficiently
  • Keep your site fast with a lightweight architecture
  • Manage SEO from a single, clean dashboard

Core SEO Features

On-Page SEO
* Meta titles and meta descriptions
* Search appearance controls
* Most advanced brand new One click auto Meta titles and meta descriptions inserter tool
* Asiiatube, Facebook, Twitter, and all other social media previews
* SEO-friendly metadata templates

Technical SEO
* Broken links checkup
* Internal linking doctor
* Cornerstone content
* One click auto internal linking
* Technical SEO checks to identify common site issues
* Support for crawlability and indexability best practices
* XML sitemap and search-engine friendly configuration
* Tools designed to help maintain a clean technical SEO setup

** Local SEO **
* Local SEO settings for business information
* Support for common local details (name, address, phone, service area)
* Built to improve local search presentation (when configured)

Schema & Structured Data
* Schema markup controls
* Structured data configuration for better search presentation

XML Sitemaps
* XML sitemap generator
* Index sitemaps and taxonomy sitemaps
* Search-engine friendly sitemap structure

SEO Audits & Checks
* On-page SEO audits
* Actionable and prioritized recommendations
* Technical and content-level insights

Keyword Insights & Content Workflow

  • Keyword opportunities with commercial-intent indicators
  • Prioritization signals to focus on higher-value topics
  • AI-assisted content drafts (optional, via Keekan Cloud)
  • Scalable content workflows for growing websites

Designed for Business-Focused Sites

Keekan SEO is ideal for:

  • Publishers and niche content websites
  • Job portals and directory-style sites
  • News and publishing media sites
  • Monetized blogs and content networks
  • Businesses targeting high-intent search traffic
  • SEO professionals managing scalable projects

Local + Cloud Architecture

Core SEO features run locally on your WordPress site, including:
* Meta tags
* Schema markup
* XML sitemaps
* Search appearance settings

Advanced keyword intelligence, AI workflows, and analytics can be enabled by connecting securely to Keekan Cloud using a connection token.

This hybrid approach ensures:
* Fast performance
* Minimal server load
* Access to advanced AI-powered SEO capabilities
sections.installation:
1. Upload the keekan-seo folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install via WordPress Admin.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu.
  3. Open Keekan SEO from the WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. (Optional) Connect your Keekan account to enable cloud-based features.
sections.faq:
Is Keekan SEO free?

Core on-page SEO, schema, and sitemap features work locally. Advanced AI and analytics features require a Keekan account.

Does Keekan SEO guarantee rankings or results?

No. SEO results depend on many factors. Keekan SEO helps you apply best practices and focus on higher-value opportunities.

Is this an AI SEO plugin?

Keekan SEO includes AI-assisted workflows for keyword insights and content creation when connected to Keekan Cloud.

Will this plugin slow down my site?

No. Keekan SEO is designed to be lightweight and loads assets only where needed.

Does it work with caching plugins and CDNs?

Yes. Keekan SEO is compatible with popular caching plugins and content delivery networks.
